mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports membrane permeabilization imaging at 100, 200, and 400 ug/mL; exact cell counts/intensity values are not tabulated locally.

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports dose-associated ROS imaging but does not provide parser-supported numeric fluorescence intensity values.
